text: 国务院台办举行例行新闻发布会。有记者问：近期民进党当局举行所谓“汉光42号演习”，首度纳入移动电话网络降速演练。岛内社会质疑这种“断网”演练导致民众不能叫外卖，也无法使用支付卡消费，正常生活受到影响。请问发言人对此有何评论？
text_en: The State Council Taiwan Affairs Office held a regular press conference. A reporter asked: Recently, the DPP authorities held the so-called 'Han Kuang 42 exercise,' which for the first time included a mobile network slowdown drill. Society on the island questioned that this 'network disconnection' drill prevents people from ordering food delivery or using payment cards for purchases, disrupting daily life. What is the spokesperson's comment on this?
